Step: Click the "What needs to be done?" input field
Expected Result: Input field is focused

Name: EP - Add a valid todo item

Name: EP - Add a valid todo item
Expected Result: New todo item "Buy groceries" appears in the list; input field is cleared; footer shows "1 item left"

Name: EP - Submit empty input does not add item
Preconditions: TodoMVC app is open; todo list is empty
Step: Click the input field and press Enter without typing anything
Expected Result: No new item is added to the list; list remains empty

Name: BVA - Add todo with minimum length
Step: Type a 2-character todo in the input
Expected Result: Characters appear in input

Name: BVA - Add todo with minimum length
Expected Result: Todo item "Hi" is added to the list; footer shows "1 item left"

Name: ST - Mark todo as completed
Preconditions: 1 active todo "Walk the dog" exists in the list
Step: Click the circle checkbox on the left of the todo item
Expected Result: Checkbox becomes checked; todo text has strikethrough styling; footer count decreases by 1

Name: ST - Unmark a completed todo
Preconditions: 1 completed todo "Walk the dog" exists in the list
Step: Click the checked checkbox of the completed todo
Expected Result: Checkbox becomes unchecked; strikethrough is removed; footer count increases by 1

Name: ST - Delete a todo item
Preconditions: 1 todo "Take out trash" exists in the list
Expected Result: Delete (×) button becomes visible on the right side

Name: ST - Delete a todo item
Expected Result: Todo item "Take out trash" is removed from the list; list is empty; footer disappears

Name: ST - Filter Active shows only active todos
Expected Result: Only "Pay bills" is visible; "Call mom" is hidden; "Active" filter link is highlighted

Name: ST - Filter Completed shows only completed todos
Expected Result: Only "Call mom" is visible; "Pay bills" is hidden; "Completed" filter link is highlighted

Name: ST - Filter All shows all todos
Preconditions: 2 todos exist: "Pay bills" (active) and "Call mom" (completed); currently on Active filter
Expected Result: Both todos are visible; "All" filter link is highlighted

Name: ST - Clear completed removes only completed todos
Expected Result: Only "Pay bills" remains in the list; "Call mom" is removed; footer shows "1 item left"; "Clear completed" button disappears

Name: DT - Footer shows correct count for 2 active items
Preconditions: TodoMVC app is open; todo list is empty
Expected Result: Footer displays "2 items left"
